hooks.text: Astronomers tracked a deep-space object heading straight for Earth.
An incoming killer asteroid turned out to be hollow space debris.
A three-foot deep-space object triggered impact warnings for Earth.

title: The Deep-Space Mystery That Struck Earth
description: Astronomers tracked mystery object WT1190F on a crash course with Earth before discovering it was hollow lunar space debris.

beats.text: Astronomers tracked a deep-space object heading straight for Earth.
beats.visual: Catalina Sky Survey telescope dome at Mount Lemmon under night sky, 2015
queries: Catalina Sky Survey telescope Mount Lemmon

beats.text: The body measured approximately three feet across.
beats.visual: Illustration of a three-foot metallic object floating in deep space, 2015
queries: hollow rocket stage in orbit illustration

beats.text: It swung past the Moon every 23 days.
beats.visual: Diagram of highly eccentric geocentric orbit extending past the Moon, 2015
queries: eccentric Earth orbit diagram lunar distance

beats.text: Density estimates showed it was lighter than solid rock.
beats.visual: Data graph showing radiation pressure solar perturbation on low density object, 2015

beats.text: Scientists realized it was a hollow, discarded rocket tank.
beats.visual: Artist rendering of spent Apollo era rocket stage orbiting in deep space, 2015

beats.text: It struck the atmosphere at nearly 25,000 miles per hour.
beats.visual: Computer simulation of space object atmospheric entry trajectory, 2015
queries: atmospheric entry fire simulation computer model

beats.text: Clouds in Sri Lanka blocked the daytime fireball.

beats.text: So researchers flew in a chartered jet to record the burn.

beats.text: They turned forgotten trash into a drill for an object heading straight for Earth.

better_than_last: Applied strict scale ladder progression from size to lunar distance to entry speed, ending on a seamless loop sentence echoing the hook's spatial imagery.
